title: Side setback, walls up to 3.5 m high (R2-R25)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. ii. For R2-R25, the stated setback distances may be reduced by half the width of an adjoining pedestrian access way to a maximum reduction of 2m (refer to Figure 3.4d). Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, side setback: R2 10m; R2.5 7.5m; R5 and above, Wall height up to 3.5m: 1m.

replaces.note: R2 10 m and R2.5 7.5 m unchanged; R5+ now by wall height only
wall length and major-opening dimensions dropped
reduction by half an adjoining ROW, pedestrian access way, communal street or battleaxe leg -> pedestrian access way only (register ch3-058)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: Chapter 3 C3.4.1(ii) (p33) limits the pedestrian access way reduction to R2-R25 (Chapter 2: R2-R40), so coding narrows from R2-R40 to R2-R25; R30-R40 move to the companion rule without the reduction (#...-r30-r40). R2 and R2.5 have flat side setbacks (10 m, 7.5 m) regardless of wall height. Reduction (ii) is limited to a pedestrian access way (ROW, communal street and battleaxe leg credits of Part B dropped, register ch3-058). Rounding gap between bands unresolved. Exception source text keeps the Chapter 2 page. Applies only where the building has walls up to 3.5 m high (condition on building.has_walls_to_3_5m); the band does not depend on the building's maximum wall height.
